restart: Original selected initial coordinates and entire original control history; no rejected restart

morphology.largest_members: exact fixed-ID member sets on common accepted times
morphology.edge_events: same pair and on/off sequence; physical-time tolerance 10us; unresolved right-end events reported
morphology.persistent_events: same kind, fixed IDs and member groups with 10us time tolerance; right-censored is NOT_EVALUATED

trajectory_policy: Two LUB4_DT10 short windows first; fail-stop. At most one original O/1102 10ms run only after short pass without new anomalies. LUB4_DT5 only if same LUB4_DT10 window passed. No further dt or iteration searches.
B2_policy: Conditional after A/B; fixed F10G 2kc. CPU two/four/static32 first, then at most O1102 short; same-model DT5 only after DT10 short passes. No B2 10ms or production batch.
B2_cost_admission: Bounded CPU diagnostic per accepted step <= 10x archived F10G O integration mean; no production speed claim
matched_cost: LUB2 and LUB4 same initial case/control/dt, 0.2ms, three warm repetitions; identical diagnostic and output requirements. No B64 unless separately admitted.
